name: Commenda — Entity Management, Indirect Tax, Compliance & Corporate APIs for Multinationals
description: Commenda is the all-in-one platform for Controllers, CFOs, and Heads of Tax at multinational companies. Finance teams use Commenda to manage legal entities across 100+ countries, track global compliance obligations, handle indirect tax (VAT, GST, and US sales tax) across all jurisdictions, manage transfer pricing documentation, and access professional services through a vetted marketplace — all from a single platform. Commenda also provides a suite of APIs for software developers: the Global Indirect Tax API, CommendaOS entity data API, Incorporation API, Workflow Builder API, Company Name Checker API, and Address API.
